title: The Empty Circle
invitation: Mara has been waiting at the relay. The road light is out.

panels.text: Mara throws the relay switch. The hammer jerks in its bracket. She fishes out a brass token with the tip of her screwdriver.

panels.speaker: Mara Venn
panels.text: Ivo rings twice on his way home. I used to tell him once was plenty.
An open circle is stamped into the brass. Mara shelters the token under her coat. From the road below comes a voice asking if anyone can see the light.

choices.label: Make a rubbing of the token
choices.reply: The dent shows through the paper. Mara turns it toward the light. “Ore lift. I’ll know who to ask.” She calls down the road and keeps calling until the walker answers.
choices.consequence: The lift keeper can identify the stamp.

choices.label: Relight the signal for the walker
choices.reply: The fog turns amber. A walker comes up carrying a Growlithe with a sore paw. “Sorry. He usually carries on just fine.” While Mara checks the paw, the brass token slips down the bank.
choices.consequence: The walker gets off the road. The lift keeper hears who relit the lamp.

secret.title: Under the Dent
secret.hint: Take a rubbing of the mark beside the circle.
secret.text: Mara tilts the rubbing. The little nick crosses the circle clean through. It’s the punch used to sign off a repair. Whoever jammed the bell punched the token afterward.
